record.body:
## Problem

The dashboard shows efforts in a flat rail. Areas and the product roadmap have no page above the efforts. The area page lists ideas only.

## Approach

Build on `effort-area-link`. Settled from the spikes:

- An areas index at `#/areas`: one card per area. The whole card is the link, with no button. A card shows the area title, the first line of its scope, counts, and its effort names.
- Clicking a card opens the area page at `#/area/<subject>`, with a back link to the index.
- The area page has scope text, rollup stats, an Efforts section and a separate Ideas section. Ideas are plain notes with no progress and no funnel. They never appear among the efforts.
- The effort page gains an area chip and a breadcrumb that link to the area page.
- Efforts with no area show in an Unassigned group on the index.

Rejected after the spikes: a roadmap board, a lanes page, tabs, an accordion, a sidebar list, a grouped effort rail.

Open for `settle-phase`: whether promoted ideas show as reference lines on the area page.

## Exit criteria

Decide at settle-phase. The phase still ends with every acceptance passing and the Playwright test loading the index and an area page through the real server.

payload.title: Area page, roadmap lanes and area chip
